summary: Ch.1: In 2nd year, cheerful Kozume Ryo lands in the same class as Otori, a huge quiet boy everyone is scared of. Kozume keeps approaching him; after watching Otori shoot at the archery hall he is flustered and avoids it. They start eating lunch together on the rooftop. Kozume asks Otori to help him study for midterms; on the way a downpour hits and Otori invites him into his apartment, embarrassed that his room is full of cute plushies. Seeing Otori shirtless, Kozume becomes aroused and panics; it ends with Kozume kissing Otori, then apologising and running out into the rain. (Opens with a flash-forward of the kiss.)

Ch.2: Kozume stays home with a cold, ashamed of the kiss and sure Otori hates him. That evening Otori turns up at his door (remembering the way from the day before) to return his uniform. Otori offers to call the kiss an accident, blaming his girly room, but Kozume admits it was not an accident and confesses: 'I like you.' Flustered, he sends Otori home and is left wondering why Otori looked so pained.

Ch.3: A week after the confession and past the exams, Kozume avoids the rooftop. Taiga invites him to eat lunch with his group, but Otori comes to fetch him (on a pretext) and asks to talk at his place. There Otori admits he never hated the kiss, was drawn to Kozume from the start, felt lonely when he was absent, and was hurt to be sent home. Kozume insists his feelings are real and lasting; Otori smiles for the first time. They confess to each other and Otori asks to pick up where they left off: the kiss.

In the final episode, Kozume asks Otori if he wants to continue where their earlier kiss left off, and Otori shyly admits that he does. They go to bed and become physically intimate, with Kozume checking on Otori’s comfort and encouraging him to say if anything hurts. After they wake up, Otori apologizes for accidentally hugging Kozume in his sleep, but Kozume responds affectionately and says he wants to know everything about him. The chapter ends with Otori asking whether he can call Kozume “Ryo,” and Kozume saying he wants to kiss him.
